title: Lendhub provides £2.1m for Surrey residential scheme
summary:
Lendhub has provided £2.1m in development finance for a 15-unit residential scheme in Addlestone, Surrey, combining the refurbishment of an existing apartment block with new construction. The 18-month facility covers acquisition and refurbishment of 12 flats plus construction of three additional units through a rear extension.

title: Somerset holiday lodge park secures £2.69m refinance
summary:
A mixed-use holiday lodge park near Bridgwater, Somerset, has secured £2.69 million in refinancing from Atom bank, arranged by Unicorn Capital Advisory. The secured term loan completed on 16 October 2026.

title: Sowerbys acquires Birds Estate Agents’ lettings portfolio
summary:
Sowerbys has acquired the property management portfolio of Birds Estate Agents in Hunstanton, Norfolk, expanding its lettings presence in the coastal town. The transaction transfers management of Birds' rental properties, with a 22-year employee joining Sowerbys to ensure continuity for landlords and tenants.

title: £2bn Mayfair scheme launches with £83.7m show apartment
summary:
Billionaire John Caudwell has launched sales at 1 Mayfair, a £2bn residential development on South Audley Street, with a five-bedroom show apartment priced at £83.7m now available for viewing. The nine-storey scheme comprises 24 principal residences, with prices ranging from £35m to over £200m.

title: Hertfordshire estate agency collapses with £470,000 debt
summary:
Two companies operating as Mackay Property in Hertfordshire have entered creditors' voluntary liquidation owing nearly £470,000, while the founder has launched a new estate agency operation from the same premises. Mackay Property Agents Limited and Mackay Property Lettings Limited ceased trading on 8 September 2026, with HM Revenue and Customs accounting for approximately £258,000 of the total debt.

title: Landlords retaining portfolios see yields rise to 9%
summary:
Landlords who retained their rental properties are experiencing stronger tenant demand and improved yields according to industry data. Properties previously yielding 4-5% annually could now generate 7-9% following a supply shortage created by earlier portfolio sales.

title: Stow Brothers launches sixth office in Islington
summary:
Independent estate agency The Stow Brothers has opened its sixth branch at 292 Upper Street, Islington, expanding its footprint across North and East London. The new office will be led by Sales Branch Manager Russell Gooden and Lettings Branch Manager Ashley Mitson.

title: Survey finds upfront property information boosts buyer confidence
summary:
A survey by LRG has found that 41% of homebuyers would make offers with more confidence if provided with upfront surveys, legal packs and chain details, while another 41% said they would be likely to offer sooner.

title: UK house prices record steepest monthly fall since 2023
summary:
UK house prices fell 0.6% in October, the steepest monthly decline in more than three years, as elevated mortgage rates continue to weigh on market activity. The average property price stood at £296,285, marking the fourth consecutive monthly decline and the largest year-on-year fall since October 2023.

title: Rightmove lowers revenue forecasts as AI investment rises
summary:
Rightmove has downgraded its revenue growth forecasts for 2026 whilst announcing plans to accelerate its artificial intelligence development programme. The property portal now expects revenue growth of 6% to 7% for 2026, down from previous guidance of 6% to 8%.
